summary: REGRESSION PASS — all multi-company data isolation fixes verified. No brute-force lockout — 4-digit PIN is enumerable in <10k attempts. Add rate-limit / failed-attempt lockout.
Jan de Vries' PIN had to be reset in DB at the start of this run (drift from prior tests). Recommend idempotent re-seed of demo tenant PIN in lifespan() OR document as known.

/api/admin/stats is now scoped — A and B counts differ from superadmin total.

AI _collect_context appears scoped (endpoint returns 200 cleanly per admin); we did not deep-inspect prompt content for leakage, recommend a unit-level assertion against _collect_context output in a follow-up.
No ObjectId (_id) leaks observed on any endpoint touched.
